# Hermes Agents Forge — Getting Started

Point your Hermes agent at the GitHub repository and read `HERMES.md`.

**Repository:** https://github.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge

**What to do:**
1. Tell Hermes: `https://github.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge`
2. Hermes will read `HERMES.md` in the repository
3. Follow the onboarding commands in `HERMES.md`

That's it — the onboarding will guide you through everything else.
